diagnostic_job.question: Conditional on original checkpoint80, original captured iteration81 inputs/RNG/state and unchanged PPO, does the measured constant-positive-group component increase internal fixed-seed gain after the four actual native updates?
limits: This conditional old-state intervention cannot prove that the same component caused every step of the85-iteration trajectory, or prove the new method is repaired from scratch.
Whole-batch original whitening stays frozen in both diagnostic arms; no advantage recomputation or new baseline is introduced.
The removal is only the component already measured in v26: native GRPO-zero AND positive raw reward rows. It does not remove zero-reward whitening coefficients or change entropy/KL.
After native updates, the probe alone uses a fixed saved adjoint. It is not a training advantage or a full-policy gradient above block31.
No formal old run is resumed, no diagnostic checkpoint is treated as formal, no sampling/validation/GRPO rerun occurs.
GPU resources are not selected or occupied during preparation. Current formal DTPO/GRPO/PPO are not touched.

temporal_evidence_v60.scope: Join saved native trend and common-group exposure; no model or regrouping.
temporal_evidence_v60.rejected_complete_explanation: Instantaneous count of successful constant-return groups alone: their exposure decreases after61-70 while native gradient medians continue to rise. Counts are not parameter gradients.
temporal_evidence_v60.supported_chain: Old DTPO retains updates on constant-positive groups that the official GRPO multiplier nulls. Native old-state ablation changes the sign of subsequent fixed-adjoint VJP growth. Historical same-input/same-seed sensitivity accelerates in the late stage, so the relevant mechanism includes accumulated parameter/state sensitivity, not only instantaneous coefficient or sample count.
limits: Positive-only state group counts describe the observed batch, not conditional population success probabilities.

A count of8 is a fully successful native group only where task states map one-to-one to the native eight-row UIDs. Iteration81 is checked directly; earlier repeated task-state collisions cannot be universally excluded.
This is a credit-signal comparison with the original GRPO formula, not a rerun or a claim that removing this component repairs training.
Earlier initial-state groups are descriptive, except where native UIDs were actually calibrated. Zero observed collisions over8 does not prove one-to-one mapping at every iteration.
The log rates describe two completed fixed-input/seed intervals; they do not establish a global exponential or quadratic law.
A late-state conditional intervention does not identify the entire historical cumulative update path.
Official zero group multipliers block the measured constant-positive component in the new method, but this is not acceptance of the complete long-term root-cause repair.

component_definition_clarification: The intervention removes the whole saved DT PPO policy-gradient coefficient on positive-return rows with exactly zero native GRPO multiplier. It is a native reward-group row partition, not an isolated constant coefficient, a pure raw-Q ablation, or a claim that the component is noise. Original entropy and KL objectives remain in both arms.

mathematical_scope.native_score_chain: At an old-policy point without clipping, the score gradient is J_logits(theta,x)^T(e_action-p); original VERL owns token weights, microbatch/DP reduction, entropy, KL, clipping and AdamW. No replacement implementation was used.
mathematical_scope.measured_internal_gain: The fixed-adjoint probe measures the parameter VJP of the original network below block31 for the same saved inputs and same BF16 adjoints. It is a directional gain, not the full policy gradient or an operator norm.
mathematical_scope.temporal_evidence: Success-group exposure falls late while native gradient medians rise; accumulated parameter/state sensitivity is required in the explanation. Instantaneous group count alone is insufficient.

magnitude_check_only.claim: These are comparable orders of magnitude, not a forecast or proof of an exponential or quadratic growth law.

counterevidence.interpretation: Do not multiply all actual PPO gradients by the fixed-seed18.275x ratio; the original incoming gradient direction also changes.

limits: This geometric identity does not identify a Hessian direction, a particular LoRA matrix or the complete historical optimizer trajectory.
